verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents programmatic product search across 25,000+ brands and 100M+ products through one API, SDK, CLI, MCP server, and UCP. Access needs no partnership: the MCP route works without an API key, agents can pay via MPP with no signup, and API keys are free and self-service with 1,000 free monthly credits. Hands-on community reports show search does return cross-merchant results but with poor relevance and coverage limited to the US, which lowers quality but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: independent evidence of reliable relevance and price-filter adherence, and broader non-US merchant coverage.
